summary.name: Stained-Glass Light Projection
summary.visualIdentity: Jewel-colored glass panes separated by dark leading project the same image onto a cool, dim stone interior, changing into colored transmitted light with physically coherent occlusion. Source provenance is extracted; the category is Digital and 3D Aesthetics. The note says reference posters do not verify every scene in a video.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to architectural light reveals: a dim stone space that transitions into colored, projected window light. Suitable for atmospheric video sequences and short previews (a 3-second dim, blackout, colored projection sequence) and full videos adding a white bloom finale and camera moves. Interactive HTML suitability is inferred, not stated.
summary.limitations: The projection is an explicit approximation, not physically accurate refraction or caustics. Cycles caustics are unavailable. Shadow-map softness and resolution need tuning. Bloom is limited to the finale. Material colors, textures, and transmitted light are not covered by the two-color contrast check. Source-specified scene verification covers only the single reference poster; full-video scene behavior is unverified.
summary.palette: Suggested tokens, not approved exact colors: background #101216 (dark scene field), foreground #F4EEE3 (layout text, 16.235:1 contrast on background, opaque captions only), glass_ruby #A82E43, glass_sapphire #284A9D, glass_gold #D6AD52 for glass and transmitted light. Gradients are disabled; use discrete tokens. Do not recolor the room with the glass blue, and do not replace the dark background with an accent. Task-supplied exact colors override these tokens.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Source timeline: dim stone, blackout (light intensity to 0), light-up with spotlight intensity and angle sweep moving the projected pattern across the floor, then a final white bloom ramp. All values are pure functions of composition time. Camera moves appear only in the full video. Motion references are none. Interactive input behavior is unspecified.
summary.audio: Unspecified in the source. Audio direction is a task-level suggestion: ambient or sparse music, or silence, could support the dim-to-light reveal and reading holds. Voiceover and sound effects are optional and not specified. No audio assets are supplied.
summary.assetRequirements: Source-specified assets: a Canvas 2D stained-glass image painted once and used as a shared CanvasTexture for both the window emissive map and SpotLight.map. Stone grain is procedural Canvas. No external fonts, photos, or audio are supplied. Asset files are unspecified beyond these generated textures.
summary.combinations: Keep this style dominant. An authored secondary option is style-079 for architectural staging, which must keep the primary background and foreground roles, must not import its palette, and must avoid competing full-scene treatments. Use it only when the brief benefits from architectural staging. Compatibility is authored guidance, not a tested combination.
summary.productionApproach: Renderer: Three.js with MeshStandardMaterial, PBR, EffectComposer, UnrealBloomPass, and OutputPass; Canvas 2D paints the glass image. Motion: GSAP paused timeline driven by shared time. Color: chroma-js is optional for validation. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default, with Remotion only as a documented fallback. Preview is 3 seconds; the full version adds the bloom finale and camera moves. Audio is unspecified.
